svg.title: LabClear 4.0.0-rc3: data flow of one chat message
svg.desc: One customer message passes thirteen stages: the API request, the Company Harness snapshot, the input safety check, the planner, role permissions, typed tools, runtime skills, the writer, deterministic checks, the independent reviewer, the output safety check, official hospital links and storage. Model calls go through the provider gate. Steps marked with a dot are listed under Process Explainability.
svg.text: DATA FLOW OF ONE MESSAGE · LABCLEAR 4.0.0-RC3
session · CSRF · same-origin · rate limit · the answer streams as NDJSON
configuration revision, skills on/off, tool limits (one snapshot per message)
iApp OpenThai-SystemOne · anything not clearly safe is blocked
JSON plan: action, role, search terms, package IDs · sees test names, never report values
Health-check Advisor or Report Explainer · the role decides which data may be read
packages · centers · policies in parallel · compare · hospital offers · BM25 evidence · confirmed rows
reviewed instruction modules chosen for role, task and evidence · SHA-256 recorded
answer in JSON with [source-id] citations · Thai unless the customer asked for English
citations exist and support · numbers, prices and report values unchanged · one rewrite
supported by the cited content · values preserved · within scope
the same guard screens the final answer
general package questions: up to 3 VERIFIED pages, attached after every check
encrypted message, sources, steps and checks · the browser renders answer and receipt
A failed check withholds the answer and shows the step that stopped it. Report questions also pass the medical analyzer and Thai composer when that profile is configured.
